card.name: Inside fluoropyrimidine and similar drug names
card.fires_on: The ending of chemotherapy drug names such as fluoropyrim|idine and Gemcitab|ine, usually in 'in combination with' phrases. It also fires on a few small words such as 'in' after 'A laboratory test'.

modes.label: Chemo drug name endings
